testCases.title: Filter items by a specific category
steps: Navigate to the filtering section of the application.
Select a specific category to filter items.
expectedResults: The application displays items relevant to the selected category.

testCases.title: Filter items by a category with no matching items
steps: Navigate to the filtering section of the application.
Select a category that is known to have no matching items.
expectedResults: The application displays a message indicating that no items match the selected category.
